chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn al-Ja'far al-Hamadani (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us, he said: Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father Ibrahim ibn Hashim from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira from Isma'il ibn Muslim from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad from his father from his forefathers from Ali (peace be upon them), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Surely, a servant will be imprisoned for a sin from his sins for a hundred years, while looking at his wives and brothers in Paradise.

key_terms.الجنة: Paradise - the ultimate reward for the believers
key_terms.ذنب: Sin - a transgression that delays entry to Paradise
key_terms.ليحبس: Will be imprisoned/held back - detained from entering Paradise

ai.seo_question: Can a person be delayed from entering Paradise because of sins?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (S) warns that a servant of Allah may be held back from entering Paradise for up to a hundred years due to a single sin, all while watching his wives and brothers already enjoying its blessings. This hadith was transmitted through the chain of Imams from Imam Ali (AS), emphasizing the severity of sins and the anguish of being excluded from Paradise while seeing others within it.
